answer: Zephyr witness: each agent binds a ~$150 weather station, so 1,000 fakes cost $150,000 plus 1,000 distinct sites. Each epoch verifiers request its last 10 minutes of gusts and compare them with the 3 nearest stations: a real meadow mast tracks its neighbours' zephyr closely but never matches one exactly. Identities sharing a sensor report identical gusts and are merged; a replayed relic trace fails against today's front. A farm can't split one mast or bulk-buy readings. Limit: sparse in cities.
